# Hirobius Design System

> Token-first React design system for product UIs, with machine-readable context for AI agents: which component to use for each screen need, the tokens, and the rules.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/AGENTS.md): which component to use for each screen need, the imports, and the rules. Read it first.
- [hds-mcp](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/mcp/hds-mcp.mjs): MCP server over stdio: run `npx hds-mcp`. Tools `list_core`, `search_components`, `get_component`, `search_tokens`; each answer is under 2 KB.
- [ESLint plugin](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/scripts/eslint-plugin-hds/index.mjs): lint before you finish: `import hds from '@hirobius/design-system/eslint-plugin'` and spread `hds.configs.recommended` into `eslint.config.mjs`.

## Full bundle

- [llms-full.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms-full.txt): everything in one file: voice, pick by need, layout and scroll recipes, card anatomy, tokens, DESIGN.md and a props digest for every component.

## Topic slices

- [layout.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/layout.txt): screen layout recipe, card anatomy, elevation roles
- [tokens.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/tokens.txt): token rules and the quick token reference
- [scroll.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/scroll.txt): scroll-driven section recipe
- [components.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/components.txt): component inventory pointer, API pointer, props digest

## Reference data

- [hds-manifest.json](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/hds-manifest.json): component and pattern inventory, metadata and phase status.
- [component-api.json](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/src/app/data/component-api.json): prop types, unions, defaults and descriptions for every component.
- [hirobius.tokens.json](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/hirobius.tokens.json): token source of truth (W3C DTCG). Prefer `semantic.*` and `component.*` over `primitive.*`.

## Docs

- [DESIGN.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/DESIGN.md): the visual spec: surfaces, type, spacing, motion.
- [CONSUMING.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/CONSUMING.md): install, set up and use the package in an app.
- [UPGRADING.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/UPGRADING.md): move between versions: what changed and what to run.

## Optional

- [MIGRATIONS.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/MIGRATIONS.md): step-by-step notes for breaking changes.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/CHANGELOG.md): release history.
